correctness.rationale: Košir--Sethuraman identifies the actual prime component ideal (Delta,E,Psi). On X!=0 the tangent bundle is smooth. On rankY=2, invertible block operations reduce Y to diag(I2,0), and E forces the single trace-zero 2x2 X block with Delta equation a^2+bc=0. The rank-two stratum is singular and dense in the full zero-X fiber; all other X!=0 points are smooth. Dimension comparison gives codimension two. Jonov CM plus Serre R1/S2 proves normality. 20 finite-field tangent-rank checks pass, but are not the proof.

value.rationale: Determines the entire reduced singular locus and generic local ADE type for a natural infinite family of determinantal first-jet principal components, separating its normal intrinsic geometry from the reducible full jet scheme. Codimension and normality have geometric implications for divisor theory and resolution analysis; this is not a routine reformulation of a known Hilbert series or a single computed example.
